name: marginalia
description: Browser extension (Firefox + Chrome): inline follow-up comment threads on Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude

scripts.start:chrome: node build.js chrome && web-ext run --target=chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --url=https://gemini.google.com/app
scripts.lint:ext: node build.js firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: node build.js firefox && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/firefox
scripts.build:chrome: node build.js chrome && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/chrome
